summary.zh-CN: LayerNorm 对单个样本、单个 [[term:token|Token]] 的特征维做归一化：先用这一行特征自己的均值和方差标准化，再用可学习的缩放与偏移恢复合适表示。它不依赖同批次其他样本。
summary.en-US: LayerNorm normalizes the feature dimension of one [[term:token|token]] in one sample: it standardizes the row using that row's own mean and variance, then applies learnable scale and bias to restore a suitable representation. It does not depend on other samples in the batch.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: LayerNorm 在每个 Token 内部统一特征尺度，使深层网络中的数值与梯度更容易保持稳定。
coreConclusion.en-US: LayerNorm keeps feature scales aligned within each token, making values and gradients easier to stabilize in deep networks.
